{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
filtered_data = data[
    (data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) &
    (data['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Define eligible customers: loyal and returning (high-value)
eligible_data = filtered_data[filtered_data['customer_segment'].isin(['loyal', 'returning'])]

# Check the segment distribution within eligible customers by channel
print("Segment distribution among eligible customers (loyal/returning):")
print(eligible_data.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0))

# Compute conversion rates within each segment
conversion_by_segment = eligible_data.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

print("\nConversion rate by channel and segment:")
print(conversion_by_segment)

# Compute weighted average conversion rate for each channel, weighted by segment size
channel_totals = eligible_data.groupby('channel').size()

# Weighted conversion rate: sum over segments (rate * count) / total
weighted_email = (conversion_by_segment.loc['email'] * channel_totals['email']).sum() / channel_totals['email']
weighted_paid_search = (conversion_by_segment.loc['paid_search'] * channel_totals['paid_search']).sum() / channel_totals['paid_search']

print(f"\nWeighted conversion rate (email): {weighted_email:.4f}")
print(f"Weighted conversion rate (paid_search): {weighted_paid_search:.4f}")

# Final difference
diff = weighted_email - weighted_paid_search
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {diff:.6f} ({diff*100:.4f} percentage points)")"}
